source.snippet: I'm looking for a job in the Gulf region and have sent some resumes through some sites. I was approached by a site ending in '.ai' saying that I'm being considered for a role in the UAE, and that I should respond to them with my resume if I can go there in about a month. Then, two days ago I heard [they were asking for ID and CC info before an interview, and also falsifying my CV].

problem_statement: Job seekers targeting international markets (especially Gulf/MENA) cannot easily verify the legitimacy of recruiter outreach or job board contacts, leading to CV fraud, identity theft risk, and wasted time on scam 'opportunities'.
target_segment: International job seekers and hiring managers at SMEs using third-party recruitment platforms in regions with lower regulatory oversight (Gulf, MENA, Southeast Asia)
notes: Clear personal financial and safety harm (CC info demanded, CV falsified). However buyer willingness-to-pay is indirect — the victim is a job seeker, not a corporate buyer. A stronger angle would be selling recruiter/job-board vetting to HR teams or staffing agencies who bear reputational risk from scam affiliates. Single data point, low corroboration — signal strength 2.
